cohort: 17,659 parturients who underwent cesarean section under spinal anesthesia at Siriraj Hospital between July 2011 and June 2016.
finding: No cases of respiratory depression requiring naloxone reversal were observed within 24 hours after cesarean section in parturients who received 0.2 mg intrathecal morphine, although one-third experienced vomiting and/or pruritus.
